title: Applied Scientist / Applied ML Engineer
text:
The Role
We are looking for an Applied Scientist / Applied ML Engineer to design, build, and deploy machine learning models that power pricing, bidding, and decisioning on a cross-border payments platform. This role owns problems end to end, from formulation to production, and partners closely with Product and Backend Engineering.
Key Responsibilities

End-to-End ML Ownership

Own end-to-end ML solutions for pricing, bidding, and risk decisioning.

Formulate model objectives from first principles, including loss functions, constraints, and metrics, and implement them as production-grade services.

Experimentation & Iteration

Design and run experiments, including A/B tests and offline evaluations, and iterate with clear success metrics.

Production Monitoring

Monitor models in production, investigate regressions, and continuously improve performance.

Requirements
Essential

3-7 years of experience as an ML Engineer, Applied Scientist, or Data Scientist in industry.

Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience.

Strong Python skills, including pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn, plus at least one of PyTorch, TensorFlow.

Strong ML fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, regularization, feature engineering, and statistics.

Experience designing models from first principles and shipping them to production, in batch or real-time.

Hands-on experience with data pipelines and ETL, such as Airflow or Spark, and strong SQL for feature engineering.

Experience integrating ML into REST or gRPC APIs and microservice architectures.

Ability to design and interpret experiments with statistical rigor.

Strong problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and distributed teams.

Nice to Have

Optimization, bandits, or decision-making under uncertainty, including dynamic pricing and bid optimization.

Bidding, auctions, marketplace, or recommendation systems experience.

Fintech background, including payments, cross-border, lending, trading, or risk and scoring.

Fraud, AML, credit risk, or vendor risk scoring models.

Model explainability tooling, including SHAP and feature importance, for auditable decisions.

Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Docker, and MLOps basics such as model registry and CI/CD.

What We Offer

Real ML in production with direct impact on pricing, risk, and vendor decisions at scale.

Ownership of core models with room to influence architecture and roadmap.

Strong engineering peers and complex optimization problems in a high-growth fintech.

Equal Opportunities Statement
Tolken is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Position: Software Engineer II (SE 2) – Backend Platform & Data System

Position Overview

We are seeking a Software Engineer II (SE 2) to join our Core Platform team. In this role, you will implement, maintain, and optimize the real-time data pipelines, distributed storage layers, and backend microservices that drive our enterprise AI/ML Platform.

This role is focused on hands-on backend software engineering, real-time distributed systems, and leveraging modern AI development workflows. Working closely with senior engineers, you will write clean, well-tested code using Golang and Python to process high-throughput data streams via Kafka and Apache Spark. You will manage polyglot persistence models, utilizing Apache Cassandra for massive, low-latency event logs and PostgreSQL for relational metadata and transactional flows. We expect our engineers to build efficiently by incorporating AI-assisted development practices into their daily workflows. Applications are deployed and scaled within a cloud-native ecosystem powered by Amazon EKS (Kubernetes) and AWS.

Key Responsibilities

Backend Development: Write and maintain robust microservices using Golang for high-performance execution and Python for data processing layers.

AI-Assisted Engineering: Accelerate software delivery, code documentation, and unit test generation by effectively incorporating modern AI development practices into your daily programming workflow.

Polyglot Data Storage Management:

Develop and maintain scalable NoSQL data persistence layers using Apache Cassandra, optimizing data modeling and CQL queries for high-volume storage.

Design, query, and optimize relational schemas using PostgreSQL, managing indexes, configuration settings, and transactional data integrity.

Stream & Pipeline Implementation: Build and maintain scalable, event-driven data streaming pipelines utilizing Apache Kafka and real-time data processing workflows using Apache Spark.

Exposure to Kubernetes controllers or operators and the operator pattern.

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled Python & Generative AI Engineer (3–4 years experience) to design, build, and optimize scalable, cloud-native AI applications. This role blends hands-on development, system design, and applied AI engineering, with a focus on Large Language Models (LLMs) and Small Language Models (SLMs).
The ideal candidate is a strong backend engineer with experience in distributed systems and AI-driven applications, capable of owning features end-to-end while contributing to architecture, performance optimization, and model fine-tuning workflows.

Responsibilities
Develop scalable, maintainable, and high-quality backend applications using Python, FastAPI, and cloud-native technologies.
Design and build RESTful APIs and microservices with a focus on performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
Develop and integrate Generative AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector databases.
Build AI-powered services leveraging Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI application frameworks.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI-powered applications throughout the software development lifecycle.
Implement efficient data retrieval and knowledge grounding solutions using embeddings, semantic search, and vector stores.
Ensure application quality through unit testing, integration testing, code reviews, and adherence to engineering best practices.
Implement observability using structured logging, metrics, tracing, and monitoring tools to ensure operational excellence.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, security scanning, and deployment processes.
Participate in design discussions, technical reviews, and mentoring of junior engineers.
Continuously evaluate emerging AI frameworks, models, and engineering practices to improve solution quality and developer productivity.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
3-6 years of software development experience.
1+ years of hands-on experience building production-grade AI/LLM applications.
Must-Have Skills
Python Development
Strong proficiency in Python and object-oriented programming.
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Strong understanding of asynchronous programming and API development.
Knowledge of design patterns, clean code principles, and software engineering best practices.
Generative AI & LLM Engineering
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Experience with prompt engineering techniques.
Experience designing and implementing RAG applications.
Familiarity with vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or Qdrant.
Experience working with embedding models and semantic search.
AI Frameworks
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
Familiarity with AI agent development concepts and workflows.
API & Backend Development
Strong experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs.
Experience working with JSON, OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning, pagination, and error handling patterns.
Databases
Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or equivalent relational databases.
Experience with ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy.
Understanding of transaction management and query optimization.
Messaging & Distributed Systems
Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or similar messaging platforms.
Understanding of microservices and distributed system fundamentals.
Testing & Quality
Experience with PyTest and automated testing frameworks.
Familiarity with code quality tools and static code analysis.
Cloud & DevOps

As the business continues to grow, there is increased demand to enhance the enterprise level of support in the product. New enterprise customers are looking to leverage Toast technology to support the growth of their business in new ways. These exciting new opportunities will require Toast to bolster our product offerings

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast is looking for a Software engineer-I to join our enterprise Away team. You will get to work across the entire Toast platform, including the partner ecosystem. As a member of the enterprise team, you will help ensure that the product is being built to meet the new and expanding needs of these customers.

About this roll* (Responsibilities) 

Design, build, and deliver features in Toast’s enterprise management products

Ensure quality by building automated testing for changes

Roll* features out to customers, including monitoring for success

Collaborate with UX and PM on the definition and design of features  

Partner with a wide array of teams across Toast 

Work with experienced engineers to deliver design and code review

06 months - 1.5 years of experience as a software engineer.

Experience building backend services, APIs, or front ends

Comfortable working with an Object Oriented Language like Java or Kotlin

Experience building complex web applications with React is a plus

Experience building android applications with kotlin is a plus

Our Tech Stack

Toast’s products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps. Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard; we use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilizes Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end.

title: AI Engineer
text:
Recruitment Fraud Alert

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.  

What to know:

Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.

We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.

Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com 

 

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.
The Opportunity

We have an outstanding career opportunity for an AI Engineer! You will play a pivotal role in developing and implementing innovative AI solutions to enhance customer interactions, streamline processes, and drive overall business growth.

We are an extra ordinary engineering team that thrives on innovative ideas! We believe in having a dynamic engineering process but at the same time believe that processes can evolve to enhance Developer efficiencies and capabilities. We take pride in our ability to complete complex projects while delivering exceptional results to our customers. It takes great people to build great software and that’s where you come in! We thrive upon collaboration and focus our efforts on maintaining a strong diverse workforce. We hire individuals from all different backgrounds and experiences and are passionate about equality and integrity.

 What you'll do

AI Model Development: Design, develop, and deploy advanced AI models, including machine learning algorithms, natural language processing, and computer vision, to address specific customer experience challenges.

Data Analysis: Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to identify patterns, trends, and insights that inform AI model development and optimization.

Customer Experience Integration: Integrate AI solutions seamlessly into our existing customer experience systems and platforms, ensuring a cohesive and personalized customer journey.

Algorithm Optimization: Continuously refine and improve AI models to enhance their accuracy, efficiency, and effectiveness in delivering exceptional customer experiences.

title: Software Engineer
text:
Company Description
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.
Job Description
About the team
We are the Workplace engineering pillar in ServiceNow’s CRM & Industry Workflows organisation, building Workplace Service Delivery and its integrations with CSM and FSM. AI is the new baseline for how we build: it changes how engineers work and what “done” means.
The role
You will build features across the stack, working AI-native: breaking tasks into small pieces, giving AI agents the context they need, and verifying everything you ship. You own the stories you take on from implementation to production, including their correctness. There is no separate QE team to hand off to.
You will work with moderate guidance from senior engineers, with more detailed direction on new areas.
What you get to do
Build and own your work
Turn well-defined requirements into working, tested features, and ask good questions when they are not well-defined.
Build features across the stack (UI, APIs, data model, integrations) and the AI layer (agents, prompts, tools, and the context they run on), with guidance from senior engineers. Learn the parts that are new to you as you go.
Explain your work clearly: write PR descriptions and short design notes that a reviewer can follow, and demo what you built in sprint reviews.
Use AI tools effectively
Use agentic coding tools as your default way of working: give them clear context, review output critically, and never ship code you can’t explain.
Use and improve the instruction files and documentation that help agents work well in our codebase.
Keep up with AI tools and techniques, and share what you learn with your team.
Own correctness, with no handoff
Write your own unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge cases and failure modes.
Follow your work through release and fix what breaks.
Qualifications
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience building and shipping software, or an advanced degree, or equivalent work experience.
Strong in at least one programming language, with solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
Curiosity and willingness to learn new layers of the stack: front end, back end, data, integrations, and AI (agents, prompts, evaluation). You don’t need to know our technologies on day one, but you should pick up unfamiliar ones quickly, with AI tools as part of how you learn.
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in real work, and the discipline to verify their output through tests and review.
An understanding of how LLMs behave (context, hallucination) and their risks.
Initiative, good judgment within established practices, and clear written and verbal communication.
Even better if you have
A project where you built something with LLMs, agents, or RAG.
Exposure to the ServiceNow platform.
Experience with enterprise or multi-tenant SaaS products.
Additional Information

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
